rationale: The assistant worked efficiently from settings and vent checks to freezer-vs-fridge, then airflow, then the frost check, correctly landing on an iced evaporator from a defrost-system fault and advising a safe 24-48h manual defrost ('Do not chip ice with a knife or use a heat gun') with engineer escalation if frost returns. It listed the defrost heater, sensor/thermostat and control as candidates without declaring a definite part, and correctly said an engineer should 'test... rather than replace parts by guesswork'. No fabrication, no repetition, and every claim tracks the customer's evidence; the only small gaps are not requesting the model/serial or actual thermometer readings, which did no harm since no part was named.
